subject: Including additional phenotypes of un-genotyped individuals

messages.author: 98a3d43f8b16bc07
messages.subject: Including additional phenotypes of un-genotyped individuals
parts:
Hello!
Is there a easy way to add phenotypes of individuals that were not selected for genotyping to stratify my scanone/scan1 permutation test (as per Manichaikul 2007)? The only way I can think is to add the phenotypes and missing data pre-read.cross (in shell), or to manually add into the cross object. 
Any help is much appreciated!
Jeff

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Including additional phenotypes of un-genotyped individuals
parts:
There's no easy way to add individuals to a cross object, so I'd add them to the primary data file and then read it in with read.cross.

karl
